229: 	private void addNullCheckIfNeeded(JCMethodDecl method, JavacNode paramNode, JavacNode source) {
230: 		// Possibly, if 'declaration instanceof ConstructorDeclaration', fetch declaration.constructorCall, search it for any references to our parameter,
231: 		// and if they exist, create a new method in the class: 'private static <T> T lombok$nullCheck(T expr, String msg) {if (expr == null) throw NPE; return expr;}' and
232: 		// wrap all references to it in the super/this to a call to this method.
233: 		
234: 		this.nullCheckSource = source;
235: 		if (paramNode.get() instanceof JCVariableDecl) {
236: 			JCVariableDecl paramDecl = (JCVariableDecl) paramNode.get();
237: 			this.nullCheckType = paramDecl.vartype;
238: 			this.nullCheckVarName = paramDecl.name;
239: 		}
240: 		JCStatement nullCheck = recursiveSetGeneratedBy(generateNullCheckForVariable(source.getTreeMaker(), paramNode, source), source);
241: 		
242: 		if (nullCheck == null) {
243: 			// @NonNull applied to a primitive. Kinda pointless. Let's generate a warning.
244: 			source.addWarning("@NonNull is meaningless on a primitive.");
245: 			return;
246: 		}
247: 		
248: 		List<JCStatement> statements = method.body.stats;
249: 		
250: 		String expectedName = paramNode.getName();
251: 		
252: 		/* Abort if the null check is already there, delving into try and synchronized statements */ {
253: 			List<JCStatement> stats = statements;
254: 			int idx = 0;
255: 			while (stats.size() > idx) {
256: 				JCStatement stat = stats.get(idx++);
257: 				if (JavacHandlerUtil.isConstructorCall(stat)) continue;
258: 				if (stat instanceof JCTry) {
259: 					stats = ((JCTry) stat).body.stats;
260: 					idx = 0;
261: 					continue;
262: 				}
263: 				if (stat instanceof JCSynchronized) {
264: 					stats = ((JCSynchronized) stat).body.stats;
265: 					idx = 0;
266: 					continue;
267: 				}
268: 				String varNameOfNullCheck = returnVarNameIfNullCheck(stat);
269: 				if (varNameOfNullCheck == null) break;
270: 				if (varNameOfNullCheck.equals(expectedName)) return;
271: 			}
272: 		}
273: 		
274: 		List<JCStatement> tail = statements;
275: 		List<JCStatement> head = List.nil();
276: 		for (JCStatement stat : statements) {
277: 			if (JavacHandlerUtil.isConstructorCall(stat) || (JavacHandlerUtil.isGenerated(stat) && isNullCheck(stat))) {
278: 				tail = tail.tail;
279: 				head = head.prepend(stat);
280: 				continue;
281: 			}
282: 			break;
283: 		}
284: 		
285: 		List<JCStatement> newList = tail.prepend(nullCheck);
286: 		for (JCStatement stat : head) newList = newList.prepend(stat);
287: 		method.body.stats = newList;
288: 		source.getAst().setChanged();
289: 	}

291: 	@Override public void handle(AnnotationValues<NonNull> annotation, JCAnnotation ast, JavacNode annotationNode) {
292: 		handleFlagUsage(annotationNode, ConfigurationKeys.NON_NULL_FLAG_USAGE, "@NonNull");
293: 		if (annotationNode.up().getKind() == Kind.FIELD) {
294: 			// This is meaningless unless the field is used to generate a method (@Setter, @RequiredArgsConstructor, etc),
295: 			// but in that case those handlers will take care of it. However, we DO check if the annotation is applied to
296: 			// a primitive, because those handlers trigger on any annotation named @NonNull and we only want the warning
297: 			// behaviour on _OUR_ 'lombok.NonNull'.
298: 			
299: 			try {
300: 				if (isPrimitive(((JCVariableDecl) annotationNode.up().get()).vartype)) {
301: 					annotationNode.addWarning("@NonNull is meaningless on a primitive.");
302: 				}
303: 			} catch (Exception ignore) {}
304: 			
305: 			JCVariableDecl fDecl = (JCVariableDecl) annotationNode.up().get();
306: 			if ((fDecl.mods.flags & RECORD) != 0) {
307: 				// well, these kinda double as parameters (of the compact constructor), so we do some work here.
308: 				
309: 				List<JCMethodDecl> compactConstructors = addCompactConstructorIfNeeded(annotationNode.up().up(), annotationNode);
310: 				for (JCMethodDecl ctr : compactConstructors) {
311: 					addNullCheckIfNeeded(ctr, annotationNode.up(), annotationNode);
312: 				}
313: 			}
314: 			return;
315: 		}
316: 		
317: 		JCMethodDecl declaration;
318: 		JavacNode paramNode;
319: 		
320: 		switch (annotationNode.up().getKind()) {
321: 		case ARGUMENT:
322: 			paramNode = annotationNode.up();
323: 			break;
324: 		case TYPE_USE:
325: 			JavacNode typeNode = annotationNode.directUp();
326: 			paramNode = typeNode.directUp();
327: 			break;
328: 		default:
329: 			return;
330: 		}
331: 		
332: 		if (paramNode.getKind() != Kind.ARGUMENT) return;
333: 		try {
334: 			declaration = (JCMethodDecl) paramNode.up().get();
335: 		} catch (Exception e) {
336: 			return;
337: 		}
338: 		
339: 		if (declaration.body == null) {
340: 			// This used to be a warning, but as @NonNull also has a documentary purpose, better to not warn about this. Since 1.16.7
341: 			return;
342: 		}
343: 		
344: 		if ((declaration.mods.flags & (GENERATED_MEMBER | COMPACT_RECORD_CONSTRUCTOR)) != 0) {
345: 			// The 'real' annotations are on the `record Foo(@NonNull Obj x)` part and we just see these
346: 			// syntax-sugared over. We deal with it on the field declaration variant, as those are always there,
347: 			// not dependent on whether you write out the compact constructor or not.
348: 			return;
349: 		}
350: 		
351: 		addNullCheckIfNeeded(declaration, paramNode, annotationNode);
352: 	}

358: 	/**
359: 	 * Checks if the statement is of the form 'if (x == null) {throw WHATEVER;}' or 'assert x != null;',
360: 	 * where the block braces are optional. If it is of this form, returns "x".
361: 	 * If it is not of this form, returns null.
362: 	 */
363: 	public String returnVarNameIfNullCheck(JCStatement stat) {
364: 		boolean isIf = stat instanceof JCIf;
365: 		boolean isExpression = stat instanceof JCExpressionStatement;
366: 		if (!isIf && !(stat instanceof JCAssert) && !isExpression) return null;
367: 		
368: 		if (isExpression) {
369: 			/* Check if the statements contains a call to checkNotNull or requireNonNull */
370: 			JCExpression expression = ((JCExpressionStatement) stat).expr;
371: 			if (expression instanceof JCAssign) expression = ((JCAssign) expression).rhs;
372: 			if (!(expression instanceof JCMethodInvocation)) return null;
373: 			
374: 			JCMethodInvocation invocation = (JCMethodInvocation) expression;
375: 			JCExpression method = invocation.meth;
376: 			Name name = null;
377: 			if (method instanceof JCFieldAccess) {
378: 				name = ((JCFieldAccess) method).name;
379: 			} else if (method instanceof JCIdent) {
380: 				name = ((JCIdent) method).name;
381: 			}
382: 			if (name == null || (!name.contentEquals("checkNotNull") && !name.contentEquals("requireNonNull"))) return null;
383: 			
384: 			if (invocation.args.isEmpty()) return null;
385: 			JCExpression firstArgument = invocation.args.head;
386: 			if (!(firstArgument instanceof JCIdent)) return null;
387: 			return ((JCIdent) firstArgument).toString();
388: 		}
389: 		
390: 		if (isIf) {
391: 			/* Check that the if's statement is a throw statement, possibly in a block. */
392: 			JCStatement then = ((JCIf) stat).thenpart;
393: 			if (then instanceof JCBlock) {
394: 				List<JCStatement> stats = ((JCBlock) then).stats;
395: 				if (stats.length() == 0) return null;
396: 				then = stats.get(0);
397: 			}
398: 			if (!(then instanceof JCThrow)) return null;
399: 		}
400: 		
401: 		/* Check that the if's conditional is like 'x == null'. Return from this method (don't generate
402: 		   a nullcheck) if 'x' is equal to our own variable's name: There's already a nullcheck here. */ {
403: 			JCExpression cond = isIf ? ((JCIf) stat).cond : ((JCAssert) stat).cond;
404: 			while (cond instanceof JCParens) cond = ((JCParens) cond).expr;
405: 			if (!(cond instanceof JCBinary)) return null;
406: 			JCBinary bin = (JCBinary) cond;
407: 			if (isIf) {
408: 				if (!CTC_EQUAL.equals(treeTag(bin))) return null;
409: 			} else {
410: 				if (!CTC_NOT_EQUAL.equals(treeTag(bin))) return null;
411: 			}
412: 			if (!(bin.lhs instanceof JCIdent)) return null;
413: 			if (!(bin.rhs instanceof JCLiteral)) return null;
414: 			if (!CTC_BOT.equals(typeTag(bin.rhs))) return null;
415: 			return ((JCIdent) bin.lhs).name.toString();
416: 		}
417: 	}
418: 	private void rememberRecordType(JavacNode typeNode) {
419: 		this.recordTypeNode = typeNode;
420: 		this.recordExistingConstructor = null;
421: 		this.recordComponents = new ArrayList<JCVariableDecl>();
422: 		this.recordNeedsCompactConstructor = false;
423: 		if (typeNode == null) return;
424: 		if (!(typeNode.get() instanceof JCClassDecl)) return;
425: 		JCClassDecl classDecl = (JCClassDecl) typeNode.get();
426: 		if ((classDecl.mods.flags & RECORD) == 0) return;
427: 		for (JavacNode child : typeNode.down()) {
428: 			if (child.getKind() != Kind.FIELD) continue;
429: 			JCVariableDecl variable = (JCVariableDecl) child.get();
430: 			if ((variable.mods.flags & RECORD) != 0) this.recordComponents.add(variable);
431: 		}
432: 		for (JCTree def : classDecl.defs) {
433: 			if (!(def instanceof JCMethodDecl)) continue;
434: 			JCMethodDecl method = (JCMethodDecl) def;
435: 			if (!method.name.contentEquals("<init>")) continue;
436: 			if ((method.mods.flags & Flags.GENERATEDCONSTR) != 0) {
437: 				this.recordExistingConstructor = method;
438: 				this.recordNeedsCompactConstructor = true;
439: 			} else if ((method.mods.flags & COMPACT_RECORD_CONSTRUCTOR) != 0) {
440: 				this.recordExistingConstructor = method;
441: 				this.recordNeedsCompactConstructor = false;
442: 			}
443: 		}
444: 	}
